gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}: reads the live settings, for the report and for sync
gh pr list --state all: reads every PR, for the branch roster the report and prune share
gh repo view: reads the default branch, when the base is not given
git remote prune --dry-run origin: asks the remote which tracking refs it has dropped
git fetch --quiet origin <branch>: reads this checkout's own upstream, for the checkout row
git fetch --quiet origin refs/pull/<n>/h: holds a merged PR's recorded head before a local branch's containment in it is judged, where this checkout lacks the object

explanation.forge settings: the forge's merge settings, declared in src/main/cli/forge/forge.csv and compared row by row with what the forge holds for this checkout's remote; a drift carries corpus-yoga forge sync as its remedy, and a forge not read says why under live
explanation.branches: each branch the forge or this clone holds, and whether it is kept or deletable - its work merged, or its PR superseded - judged against the merged head the forge recorded, fetched where this checkout lacks it, and unverified where it cannot be held; corpus-yoga forge clean removes the deletable, and a branch kept on evidence carries the reader's act as its remedy, which bare status says
explanation.remote-tracking refs: the refs this clone keeps for branches the forge has deleted, each stale one by name
explanation.now: the room's standing as the forge reads it - corpus-yoga forge clean, what it would do, and each deletable branch and stale tracking ref it would remove by name; each open PR's merge over its head branch, while no refuse-class drift stands; the workflow's steps, which remedy nothing. none where the forge holds nothing to remove and no PR is open; unread where the forge was not asked
explanation.this checkout: the branch the checkout is on against its upstream, and the commit hook, as corpus-yoga test says it
